reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel post-sintering heat treatment to induce controlled nano-oxide precipitation from residual oxygen, an approach not reported in the provided passages. While the individual elements (TaNbVTi matrix, TiO precipitates, precipitation strengthening) are known, the specific intervention of a rapid, high-temperature anneal to utilize intrinsic oxygen for dispersoid formation, and the integration of this with SPS processing to balance high-temperature strength, density, and room-temperature ductility, represents a new synthesis not suggested by any single passage or combination thereof.
